title: chtypes v1 scripted HTTP response sequence
description: A scripted sequence of responses the fixtures/server/parity lane's scripted HTTP server (under scripts/fetch-v1/) serves for one or more paths, for the retry, redirect and auth cases (docs/guides/fetch-v1.md §10, once that lane fills it in). An unscripted path falls through to the named route tree.

tree.description: The route tree this script falls through to for any unscripted path.

second_origin_routes.description: Routes served on the server's second origin (the port after LISTENING's second number), for cross-origin redirect cases.

responses.description: Consumed in order, one per request to this route; the last entry repeats for any further request past the end of the list.

oneOf.description: Serve this request from the named route tree instead of a scripted status.
Hold the connection open past the test-only idle timeout; never resolves.
Reset the connection with no response at all.

body_from_tree.description: When true, the response body is the named route tree's bytes for this path; otherwise the body is empty.
